steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates said legacy computer makers like IBM were flying as unprecedented AI demand lifted hardware sales, placing IBM within the broader AI supply chain.

episode.title: AI & Robotics: From $300bn to $5.2 trillion in three years | The Decade Ahead

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates explained IBM’s AI generated tennis commentary used match stats and specialist language input to narrate Wimbledon highlights, showing a practical entertainment application of its AI tools.

episode.title: Apple is the first $3 trillion company. Should I care?

views.text: In November 2020, Equity Mates noted IBM had started offering quantum computing as a service, giving organisations on-demand access to next generation compute for problems classical computers struggle with.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In September 2024, Equity Mates contrasted index leaders over decades, noting IBM slid from number 1 in 1980 to 53rd by 2020 and delivered about 400% in 40 years, far behind the index’s 13000%.

episode.title: Why Index Investing: Because indexes are forever | iShares by BlackRock

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates recounted that IBM dominated in the 1980s but then fell away, illustrating how even cutting edge leaders can be disrupted over time.

episode.title: Why companies die but indexes are forever, Pimp my portfolio & ETF overlap

views.text: In October 2023, a guest on Equity Mates described IBM’s 1970s antitrust battle as evidence of its once formidable market power, with legal spending outstripping the U.S. government’s antitrust division annually.

episode.title: Expert: Cory Doctorow - This guy HATES big tech & plans to change it
